appliesTo: Updates within NEW io.github.rebrowser v2 line; not migration from io.github.reoutlook v1
platformFacts: Android rejects normal same-package replacement by an unrelated signer; lawful signing rotation must follow Android rules.
A correct recovery APK must satisfy signature/lineage and non-downgrade version rules; old lower-code APK reinstall is not automatically possible.
Same-signing-key arbitrary malicious update code can change/remove in-app checks and access the same sandbox; local self-check is not an absolute defense against that threat.
First install has no previous local root baseline. Official source/certificate verification cannot be bootstrapped by a fork checking its own modified constant.
Logical delete plus cryptographic key destruction can invalidate owned encrypted data; flash/OS backups cannot be promised physically overwritten by ordinary app code.
proposedInvariants: Check continuity BEFORE any Gecko profile/mail DB/background task/plugin/IPC access to old epoch.
Keep old encrypted data and required keys recoverable until final personally confirmed destructive commit.
No background timer, launch counter, cancellation, failed dialog or administrator exemption substitutes for personal confirmations.
Destroy task binds exact old root/data epoch and app-owned internal paths/keys; never root-folder recursion across packages or shared/public storage.
Never touch old io.github.reoutlook app, public Downloads, exports, media, other apps, or remote/cloud mailbox.
Correct-root rescue must be validated with a real permitted recovery version before release.
After irreversible key destruction do not claim a correct package can still restore lost data.
Only a truly fresh installation with no old data epoch may seed initial trust. Missing/tampered root marker while old data exists must lock, not silently create a new root or erase data.
Initial source trust click only advances the warning flow; it does NOT unlock business, access old data, overwrite trusted baseline or authorize erasure.
Fresh system owner verification is separately required after FORCE_2 and FORCE_3 clicks unless OS positively confirms no screen-lock credential.
Normal operations unlock only AFTER exact authorized private old-epoch deletion completes and is verified.
A→abnormal B→normal successor C preserves A trusted source/data through B; C must not be judged against B.
Treat the owner example wording 上一个包 as last NORMAL trusted source in comparison logic, never overwrite authority with the anomalous predecessor.
sourceIdentity: Tuple(actual trusted APK signing identity, compiled root-admin public-key identity)

trustedBaselineRule.authoritative: lastKnownGoodSource bound to preserved data epoch
trustedBaselineRule.beforeFinalErasure: Never overwrite lastKnownGoodSource merely on abnormal package installation, initial trust click, or partial confirmations.
trustedBaselineRule.recovery: Normal successor with same trusted source compares against lastKnownGoodSource, not intermediate abnormal source.
trustedBaselineRule.afterEraseProposal: Only after authorized irreversible erasure and successful fresh-epoch creation commit the accepted new source as its new baseline; never promise old-data recovery afterward.
